name: The St. Regis London
positioning: Mayfair hotel at the junction of Conduit Street and Bond Street, with Le Perroquet by Chef Daniel Rose and St. Regis rituals such as Butler Service and Champagne Sabering
best_for: Travelers who want a Mayfair base amongst designer boutiques, art galleries and dining hubs
Guests who enjoy St. Regis rituals such as Butler Service, Champagne Sabering and Midnight Suppers
Travelers bringing one pet of up to 25kg

facts.text: The hotel is set amongst London's designer boutiques, art galleries and dining and social hubs.
Le Perroquet is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner, with a smart casual dress code.
The hotel has two spa suites and a fully equipped gym.
Rooms come with fine linens, a pillow menu and selected in-room refreshments.
Rooms are designed with contemporary glamour reflecting Mayfair's fashion, art and cultural spirit.
The Penthouse Suite is the largest-occupancy room, for up to 6 guests.
Pets are welcome: one pet per room up to 25kg, with a non-refundable fee.
Nearby Underground stations include Bond Street, Oxford Circus and Green Park.

highlights.text: The hotel is in Mayfair, at the junction of Conduit Street and Bond Street.
Le Perroquet is an all-day French brasserie by Chef Daniel Rose.
Hotel rituals include the St. Regis Butler Service, Champagne Sabering and Midnight Suppers, inspired by the Astor legacy and Caroline Astor.
Rooms have generous windows with views of Bond and Conduit Streets.

considerations.text: Rooms do not have a fridge.
Breakfast is available at Le Perroquet for a fee.
The hotel does not provide an airport shuttle from Heathrow.
